infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vibes uses your camera so you can take profile photos and cover images for events or challenges, for example taking a new profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Vibes uses your photo library so you can choose profile photos and cover images for events or challenges, for example uploading a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Vibes uses your location while the app is open to suggest nearby people and events, for example filling in your city during onboarding.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Vibes uses your location to suggest nearby people and events, for example filling in your city during onboarding.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Vibes uses your location to suggest nearby people and events, for example filling in your city during onboarding.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vibes usa el micrófono cuando elegís grabar un audio para un día de tu desafío.

android.extraProguardRules:
# JNA references desktop AWT APIs that are unavailable and unused on Android.
-dontwarn java.awt.Component
-dontwarn java.awt.GraphicsEnvironment
-dontwarn java.awt.HeadlessException
-dontwarn java.awt.Window
